title: Randy W
content: I was napping at the age of three when a dream woke me. The room was filled with an unusual light. I knew immediately that the dream was so realistic it was not a dream but a memory. Most dreams are forgotten within minutes of waking, but I have never forgotten these events. At the time, I told no one. I would occasionally review the dream, but around puberty I decided to suppress it. I did that successfully for years. My health is now declining. I heard a voice that said my health would continue to worsen until I shared the memory and the messages. The following events happened before I was born. The memory started with my soul being a multicolored orb. I was with thousands of other orbs, all of us with constantly color-changing bodies. We were all flying through the galaxies at the speed of light. We looked like a gigantic school of fish. The leader would make daring turns and twists and we all followed. The goal was to be asked to be the leader. It was accelerating. I had no interest in doing anything else. At one point, a large square door opened in the middle of dark space. It lit up with a beam of light pointing at some beings directly in front of me. Standing at the opening was a tall, slender female figure beaming in light and waving for these orbs to fly into the door. These beings veered off from the pack and flew into the opening. My curiosity got the best of me, so I followed my friends. The lady in white was motioning for me to stop, but I followed anyway. I entered a building I never knew existed. Tens of thousands of orbs and angels filled the room. We were all dressed in white. The angelic figures all manned a workstation. The orbs were all in different queues. I fell in line behind my friends. While waiting for our turn, it was explained to me that this space was for sending and receiving souls from and to Earth. I had no idea what I was getting into, but the entire room buzzed with shared thoughts about this adventure. The longer I stayed in line, the more I learned about the adventure ahead of us. My turn in line did not go smoothly. The advisor wanted to know what preparatory work I had done to go to another planet. I told her the truth, but I still wanted to go. My advisor and someone in charge were both summoned. These beings tried to persuade me to go back to my flying. No matter what I was told, I refused to leave the line. All at once, the room filled with a bright light. It was not blinding, but the entire room took notice. All thoughts and sounds stopped. Everyone became reverent. He was about nine feet tall with a kind, bearded face. His eyes were kind, but I knew if this Being told me to get out of line, I would have no other choice. I had never seen him before, but I knew this was Jesus Christ. He asked the angelic figure what was happening. She introduced me and added the following, "This soul wants to go to Earth. He has no title, no status, no preparation, nor any history. He has spent his entire time frolicking through the universes. We have all explained to him that Earth is not an adventure and it is hard on the soul. But he refuses to vacate the queue." Jesus looked at me and asked why I wanted to go to Earth. "I want to be a spiritual warrior," I said. I had heard others use this answer. Jesus laughed. Then he asked, "What will you do when you encounter the other side?" "I will call your name for help." Again Jesus laughed. "He has been warned, and we do have free will. Give him two older brothers to protect him. Give him two younger sisters to guide him emotionally. Make sure he is not conscripted into war. Give him enough problems so he learns how cruel the world can be." Then he addressed me. "Earth is more than the adventure you are looking for. Your assumptive thinking worked, but we all have a purpose when we take an earthly body. Your purpose will not be as hard as mine, but I will ask you to give a message to the world. You will be branded a liar by your friends and family. This news has no effect on you now, but it will not be easy when this happens. You have been warned in a loving way." He left as quickly as he had come. So they processed me. I do not want to tell my entire life story, but it was hard. I was not ready for Earth. I made all of my important decisions based on fear. I married out of fear of being alone. I took on a career I knew I would be good at instead of choosing one born of passion. I am now a retired sales manager who rose to mid-management. I spent half my life claiming to be agnostic and have stayed on the fence on most matters. Now my health is declining. I lost my colon and almost lost my life due to complications from hospital-acquired pneumonia. I had a spiritual awakening in the hospital and am now trying to be the man God wants me to be. My health is declining, but I heard a voice telling me to give the world two messages. I want to be clear. There are a multitude of others who have also received these messages. If you are reading this, you have now been asked to spread the news. I feel like I am preaching to the choir on this forum, but I am to urge anyone who has had an NDE to share it with the world. Galileo was imprisoned in 1633 for claiming the Earth was not the center of the universe. The Catholic Church did not admit he was correct until 1992. There now exist ledgers of educated scholars who proclaim that our consciousness does not die. God does not want us to wait 300 years before the world agrees with the evidence. Schools, governments, and churches now need to be urged to recognize the fact that there is an afterlife. The second message is about each of our purposes on this planet. Jesus said in the Lord's Prayer, "Your kingdom come, your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven." This prayer has been misunderstood. It has people waiting for Jesus instead of working to make Earth as it is in heaven. God says we shall soon have the technology to turn our planet into a paradise, but it will take all of us to make this shift happen. We can feed the poor, we can heal the sick, and we need to get rid of greed and corruption to do this. In heaven, leaders are given their roles only if they have kindness, integrity, and understanding. That has to happen here if the world is going to make the shift that God has intended for us. I have been told I will be ridiculed for sharing my memory, but it is what is asked of me.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No, rebirth experience, Other (briefly specify), dreamed of a memory from age three
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, In heaven, I had knowledge available.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, All light came from within the souls.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, I was flying through space. It all seemed natural.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes, I investigated all forms of religion after my awakening. I found Emanuel Swedenborg.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I had no knowledge of God.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, I encountered Jesus.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes, Jesus appeared as a bright light with his face beaming kindness.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, Our purpose is to create the same love as in Heaven.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, My life now has meaning.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, Words cannot totally explain where I was.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, It has been 67 years and I still remember the experience vividly.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, I am an empath and I hated feeling the hate and anger of others. I could always tell who was lying. Dealing with crowds was awful.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: My wife and I were pulled from a head-on collision seconds before it happened. I thought it was a miracle.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, Years later I decided it was a dream. Decades later when facing death I remembered it as reality.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was probably real, God has asked me to share this experience. I know it's real.
